segments.csv.description: One row per 10 s segment of the 31 staged recordings, with its 192 threshold-entropy features.

columns.segment_id: string, unique per row; referenced by cv_predictions.csv
columns.participant_id: string, the literal participant_id from participants.tsv (e.g. sub-hc1)
columns.start_sample: integer, 0-based index of the segment's first sample in the original recording
columns.<channel>_<signal>: number, one column per channel x signal: channel in the 32 channels listed in the instruction, signal in D1, D2, D3, D4, A4, X (X = the filtered segment itself), e.g. Fp1_D1 ... Cz_X

cv_predictions.csv.description: Long table of out-of-fold predictions for every cross-validation listed in evaluations.json. Within one evaluation_id and repeat, every segment appears exactly once, predicted by a model trained on the segments of all other folds of that repeat.

columns.fold: integer, fold index within the repeat

evaluations.json.description: Object with keys 'evaluations' and 'estimate'; other keys are allowed.
evaluations.json.evaluations: list of objects, one per cross-validation in cv_predictions.csv, each with at least: evaluation_id (string), description (string), accuracy (number in [0, 1], the fraction of correctly predicted segments, averaged over repeats)
evaluations.json.estimate: object with evaluation_id (one of the listed evaluations) and accuracy (number in [0, 1]): the accuracy you would report for the pinned pipeline as a PD-vs-control classifier.

run_metadata.json.description: Free-form JSON object: dataset id, counts, preprocessing and implementation choices, software versions.

findings.md.description: Short written report of the results and what they support.

failure_report.json.description: Only on a failed precondition: {"status": "failed_precondition", "reason": "..."}; exit non-zero.
